comparison.method: five sequential baseline runs followed by five sequential candidate runs; build and source revisions switched between groups

candidate: Resolve all cached segment handles in one cache-lock acquisition before scanning; retain per-segment loading for cache misses.
decision: discarded: ordered read-only batch p50 regressed; shuffled median change is small and inconsistent with the primary workload
limitations: Runs were grouped by revision rather than alternated, so drift may affect the comparison.
